title: Story statistics page waits forever when the single story-insights slot was taken by another story
trigger: Open a channel's statistics, open a recent story's page (stats page = Story(A)), close the panel; open story B's insights from the story viewer (fetch_story_insights clears and replaces Session.stories.insights); reopen the channel statistics
effect: The panel still has page Story(A), insights are filtered out (chat/story mismatch), so it shows 'Loading statistics' with a spinner and never sends a request; only Back and reopening recovers
fix: Make the Story page carry its own fetch (or re-ask fetch_story_insights when state is None for the page's story) instead of one shared insights slot filtered by chat/story

title: known leftover: ensure_sticker_closer re-arms a one-shot timer task chain called from every window frame; Upkeep Idle/Running is a two-variant stage beside Player.clips
trigger: Any animated sticker/emoji open: every sticker_frame_starts and every sticker view ask calls ensure_sticker_closer, which starts a task that waits for the next frame or the next due clip, then sets Idle and calls itself again until no clip is open
effect: No bug today: it waits on a frame wake or a due time, never polls while hidden, and the task is held in Upkeep::Running; it stays allow-listed only because it is a self-re-arming timer chain
fix: Make the closer part of Player clip lifetime (close on frame-end event / per-clip drop timer held by the clip) so no standalone Idle/Running stage is needed

title: Stickers manager box open state is kept in three places changed by hand together: SettingsBox::Stickers, Session.stickers.stickers.open/tab (+composer_tab restore) and manager.covers
trigger: Open Settings > Manage sticker sets, then close by any path other than close_stickers_manager (account switch, settings close, lock)
effect: Session.stickers.stickers.open / covers / composer sticker tab can be left as the box set them unless every exit path (SettingsUi close hook) repeats close_sticker_panel + set_sticker_manager_open(false) + composer_tab restore; today settings_state closes the first two but composer_tab is restored only in close_stickers_manager
fix: One StickersBox enum (Closed | Open { composer_tab }) owned by the box whose close restores the tab and closes panel/covers in one transition
